name: interaction_2d
title: 2D interactables: volumes, a player probe, pickups
summary: Area2D interactables in the "interactable" group with interact(actor), an interactor probe for the player that focuses the nearest one and fires on the interact action, and a one-shot pickup that feeds a BGInventory.
usage: Under the player add an Area2D with scripts/interactor_2d.gd and a CollisionShape2D for reach. Anything usable is an Area2D with scripts/interactable_2d.gd (or pickup_2d.gd for items); connect `interacted`, or subclass and override _on_interact. Pair with the inventory kit and pickups fill it.
